incorrect_inferences: A moving lift and bubble suggest timing pressure, but the route permits waiting on safe ground/stopped lift and the bubble repeats while OPEN is held.
changed_judgments: Cooperation rises from 2 to 3 because Pac must hold OPEN for Isp's route, then Isp's rescue latch hands off the powered lift for Pac. Timing falls from 2 to 1 because the bubble repeats and there is a safe waiting area, despite a contact choice. Hazards becomes 2 because the mandatory raised transfer spans a lethal deep moat. Clarity falls from burden 3 to 2: labels and dialogue identify the relevant controls, though the exact bubble-to-rescue relation still needs testing. Recovery is 2 because misses can be retried safely but a fall into the moat restarts the setup.
unresolved: Whether novices identify which hero should use FLOAT, and whether the lift/bubble timing feels comfortable, has no human observation.

single_operator_note: A single operator must alternate between holding OPEN, steering Isp through the bubble to RESCUE, then moving Pac on the newly powered lift; this handoff adds attention demand beyond the two-human baseline.
